subject: Aurora Payments - procurement & stakeholder map
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@aurorapay.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-14T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Aurora Payments - procurement & stakeholder map

Hi Samir — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Key business objective: reduce per-transaction latency and cost on high-throughput reconciliation jobs for Aurora Pay’s clearing flow.
- Primary success metrics: end-to-end latency < 350ms for batch inference, 25% reduction in per-call cost vs current provider, and predictable monthly spend for budgeting.

Stakeholders you mentioned:
- Economic buyer: Priya Menon (Head of Payments) — approving budget/SOW
- Procurement: Jenna Ross / procurement@aurorapay.com — onboarding, PO, invoicing
- Security: internal security team (SOC2, vendor questionnaire)

Our asks / proposed next steps: 
1) Can you confirm the economic buyer and procurement contact (we captured Priya / Jenna above)?
2) Please share procurement timeline expectations (PO lead times, PO required before prod access, standard payment terms).
3) Security: we attached our vendor questionnaire and SOC2 summary; let us know any additional evidence you need.
4) I'll follow up with a mutual action plan (MAP) outlining milestones (SOW, PO, onboarding, pilot).

Attachments: redwood_vendor_questionnaire.pdf, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

If you prefer, we can jump on a 20-min call with your procurement + security folks to speed this along — happy to coordinate.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Subject: Re: Aurora Payments - procurement & stakeholder map

Thanks Marissa — good summary. Confirming details from our side: 

- Economic buyer: Priya Menon (copied) — will sign off on SOW/PO once we have cost schedule and pilot expectations.
- Procurement: Jenna Ross (copied) — handles vendor onboarding and PO issuance.
- Security: our security team will need a SOC2 Type II and the vendor questionnaire answered. We will run a quick internal review but may request a short security call.

Procurement timeline (typical for Aurora):
- Vendor onboarding + questionnaire review: 1–2 weeks (can run parallel to SOW negotiation)
- PO issuance after SOW approval: typically 2–4 weeks depending on quarter-end budgeting; we are at the start of a new budget cycle so expect ~3 weeks.
- Payment terms: Net 45 (standard), but can be discussed.

Immediate asks for you: 
1) Please populate the vendor questionnaire and return to Jenna (copied).
2) Share a one-page SOW or pilot scope + cost estimate we can route to Priya.
3) If you have a standard vendor portal link or onboarding form, please share.

If possible, Priya and Jenna are available for a 20-min sync on Friday 18th at 11am PT. Does that work for your team?

Best,
Samir
Head of Engineering Programs | Aurora Payments
samir.shah@aurorapay.com
